name: Cognito Forms Individual Free
free_limit: Unlimited hosted forms, 100 entries/month, 100 MB storage and one user on the always-free Individual plan; supports basic calculations and payment acceptance.
watch_out: The free quota is 100 entries/month across the account, forms include Cognito branding, and advanced workflows, electronic signatures and additional users require paid plans. No card needed for Individual; commercial-use terms need confirmation.
